Prized Gladiator's Cloak refers to the following: *Prized Gladiator's Cloak (cloth) (Mage, Priest, Warlock) *Prized Gladiator's Cloak (leather) (Demon Hunter, Druid, Monk, Rogue) *Prized Gladiator's Cloak (mail) (Evoker, Hunter, Shaman) *Prized Gladiator's Cloak (plate) (Death Knight, Paladin, Warrior)
Pristine Stormgem Shard would grant three ranks of Brewing Storm.
Privateers are humans and Dark Iron dwarves who can be found on board of one of the ships docked at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. They protect the Deserter Propaganda for Propaganda War.
Pristine Gleaming Iron Spike would grant three ranks of Arcane Aegis.
Pristine Rage of the Tides would grant three ranks of Touch of Malice.
Pristine Sundered Comet would grant three ranks of Terror From Below (Legion Remix).
Pristine Xakal's Determination would grant three ranks of Temporal Retaliation.
Pristine Soul-Eater Hide drops from Prowling Soul-Eater in Ruin's Cradle in the Maw.
Graveblossom can be gathered from Blooming Graveblossoms at Windrunner Spire in Eversong Woods. Talandra Dawnsprite requests that the champion forage 8 plants to assist her in creating a poultice.
Pristine Shade Lilies are looted from Shade Lily Clusters in Amani'Zar Village in Zul'Aman. They are found growing under buildings in the shade.

Prized Fangs of the Skulking Viper can be obtained by converting another Midnight Season 2 mail belt using the Catalyst. They are part of the Skulking Viper's Ambush set but are not required to benefit from the tier bonus.

Privateer's Loop Half of Key is looted from the Waterlogged Crate underwater on the Coiled Isle with the aid of a Helpful Dolphin. Combining it with the Privateer's Teeth Half of Key creates the Amani Privateer's Key needed to unlock the Abandoned Amani Privateer's Cache.

Both Borgos in Dornogal and Sofee Batalsworn in Azj-Kahet also sell 1 Profaned Tinderbox for .

Profession specializations allow the players to specialize in their primary crafting and gathering professions once they've reached a high enough skill. Once they have earned Knowledge points through a variety of activities, they can spend them to permanently improve different areas of their profession; it is one of the main ways they can differentiate themselves from their peers.
